## Security

### AegisAI raises $36 million Series A to fight AI-powered phishing
🔥◯◯◯◯ AegisAI, a San Francisco email security startup founded in 2025 by former Google reCAPTCHA/Safe Browsing leaders Cy Khormaee and Ryan Luo, closed a $36 million Series A led by Battery Ventures with Accel and Foundation Capital, bringing total funding to $49 million. The company builds proprietary LLMs and autonomous AI agents that analyze email intent in real time rather than relying on signature-based detection, and claims up to 90% fewer false positives than conventional filters. Funds will scale its defense agents and push Vanguard, a threat-hunting agent that investigates links, attachments and sites beyond the inbox, toward general availability. AegisAI cites AI-generated spear phishing rising from 2.8% to 13.9% of attacks and FBI-reported cybercrime losses of $20.8 billion as the market driver.
Sources: [Google News — email security](https://news.google.?oc=5), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/aegisai-founded-by-former-google-security-execs-lands-36m-to-stop-ai-driven-spear-phishing/), [citybiz](https://www.citybiz.co/article/878836/aegisai-raises-36-million-series-a-to-combat-ai-powered-spear-phishing/)
